brief: Compare total ownership costs over the same stated period.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Ownership Costs"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Compara el costo de usarlo"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Compare o custo de usar"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Compare total ownership costs over the same stated period.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Buying is only one part of ownership; compare purchase, use and upkeep over the same fictional period.
instruction.misconception: The cheapest purchase price determines the cheapest ownership cost regardless of operating costs, lifespan or period.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Add purchase and stated running costs over the same period. Include maintenance and any stated resale amount consistently.
B costs less overall despite its higher purchase price.
Different periods produce incomparable operating totals.
Purchase, electricity and maintenance all belong in this stated total.
Required supplies can outweigh a low purchase price.
An unsupported lifespan can distort the ownership comparison.
The resale receipt offsets part of purchase and upkeep spending.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: Buying is only one part of ownership; compare purchase, use and upkeep over the same fictional period.
